Name: Sprigatito as cat
Author: Wandox99
Description:
Hello everyone!
This mod change the cats with Sprigatito and Shiny Sprigatito (as I can see, it change only the color of eye).



WARNING:
I'm not so good at drawing, as result Sprigatito [size=3]is [/size][size=5]really[/size][size=6]HUGE[/size][size=3]...


[/size][size=5]Install[/size]
1. Install the latest version of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. Install [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.


[size=3]If you liked the mod, please leave an endorsement![/size]



If you have suggestion or feedback feel free to write me on the [url=http://discord.gg/stardewvalley]official Discord server[/url] with the tag @Wandox#6064 in the modmaking channels.ù
